parsed.rationale: Both participating records are SwiftUI `App`-conformance `body` entry points for standalone component harness applications: `Shared/WXUI/Examples/WXUISampleApp/Sources/WXUISampleApp.swift` sits under the `Examples/` subtree and is named `WXUISampleApp`, while `Shared/PlayerHeaderView/PlayerHeaderViewApp/PlayerHeaderViewApp.swift` is the entry point for the `PlayerHeaderViewApp` preview harness. Although `is_sample_app` is recorded as `false` in both metadata records, the file paths unambiguously identify these as sample/demo app entry points, not production logic. The identical boilerplate is the expected and intentional result of each component package having its own self-contained preview app scaffold; consolidating them would couple two independent component harnesses without any production benefit.
